Join the official WhatsApp group for info: https://chat.whatsapp.com/G5a5smizs8d85Jsp9dmZzJ

Benefits and Opportunities

  • Top 3 teams: Paid internship opportunities
  • Top 3 teams: 30,000 prize pool
  • Top 3 teams: Incubation and product-development opportunities
  • Top 3 teams: Letters of Recommendation
  • Every eligible participant: One complimentary .xyz domain
  • Every eligible participant: $100 in Inkloom AI credits
  • Every eligible participant: $500 in Adaption platform credits
  • Every eligible participant: Verifiable digital certificate
  • Rewards and benefits: 100+ recipients across the hackathon

Format:

  • Hackathon Date: 3 December — 14 December 2026
  • No.of Rounds: 3
  • Mode: Completely online
  • Team size: 1–6 members
  • Registration fee: Completely free

Rules

  • Participants must submit original work within the deadline and follow all event guidelines.
  • Plagiarism, false information or multiple submissions may result in disqualification.

Eligibility

  • Open to students, developers, designers and technology enthusiasts across India.
  • Participants may join individually or form a team according to the event’s permitted team size.

Process

  • Register for the event, join the official communication group and complete every announced round.
  • Qualified participants will receive the instructions and submission details for the next stage.

 

Teams selected for Round 3 pay a participation fee of ₹399 per team — one payment for the whole team, not one each. 100 teams are selected and qualified, and all of them are mailed, but seats are limited and we have only 50. Whoever pays first gets their seat reserved. The fee covers the cost of running the event: infrastructure, the time and effort of organising it, and paying the people who do that work. Registering and Rounds 1 and 2 are free, and this is the only payment anywhere in this event. It falls due only once your team is selected for Round 3, so a team that is not selected pays nothing at all. Paying it means accepting the event participation terms, which are linked under this block and are the same for every event.
